about: Test cases for the signatures extension 0.2.0. The values they use are in vectors.json, written by generate_vectors.py (TEST KEYS ONLY); a case names them by JSON Pointer into vectors.json. Schema cases apply a patch to a base document (base) and validate it against a schema; an empty patch tests the base itself, so each negative case differs from a valid document by the one thing it tests. Vector cases recompute values in vectors.json. Person cases run the reference check of one person's signature (person: a name in vectors.json, or from and patch) in an attachment that may also hold other assertions (also) and timestamps (timestamps), read with the export (default full, patched by export_patch), the action-binding attachments (default both, patched by action_binding_patch) and the trust policy (anchoring 0.2.0's trust policy, patched by policy_patch); every dimension is expected verified, on the stated time, with the policy accepted, unless expected says otherwise. Seal cases do the same for one organisation's seal, timestamp cases for one timestamp over a signature value (held: the assertions in the attachment, each a name in vectors.json with an optional patch). Pairing cases read base_report, changed by report_patch, with the documents of base_context, changed as the case says, which JSON Schema cannot do. Patch operations: set (value, vector: a pointer into vectors.json, or digest_of: attachment, export, or action_binding:<decision_id>, as the case builds them), remove, copy (to), insert, move (to).
